== Decipher replacement text and Revised face — Story 611 ==
The original black-bordered face ([[:File:ANH-L-attackrun-decipher-archive.gif]]) prints “Z = highest ability of TIE pilots present.” The Revised white-bordered face ([[:File:ANH-L-attackrun-wb-decipher.gif]]) prints “in trench.” Glossary Version 2.0, p. 17, changes the final Proton Torpedoes line and strikes out “during Attack Run”; its p. 2 legend identifies strikeout as a deletion. The 29 January 2002 Supplement, p. 2, explicitly replaces only the last line and repeats the same corrected sentence. These two documents therefore do not establish a separate 1998 state retaining the struck-out words, nor do their Attack Run replacement paragraphs substitute “in trench” for “present.”

The Decipher text state retains the original wording except for that documented last-line replacement. The white-border image was cleared from this different text-state article; its File and Revised printing article are retained. No matching full-card face for the original-plus-last-line replacement was established in this audit, so the image field remains blank. Existing identifiers 2_42d are unchanged. The shared comparison’s Decipher column and source explanation agree. ~~~~
